title: Pure Ghoti
summary: Pure Ghoti Fish Synchro build with generic Synchros and staples. Ghoti monsters banish themselves and other Fish for cost, return to the field during the next Standby Phase, and Quick-Synchro on the opponent's turn into Ghoti of the Deep Beyond to banish the entire board.

summary.title: Starters
points: Paces, Light of the Ghoti banishes itself from the field to Special Summon a Fish monster (such as Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti or Eanoc, Sentry of the Ghoti) from your hand.
Shif, Fairy of the Ghoti banishes itself from the GY to give a Fish you control 500 ATK, setting itself up to return in the next Standby Phase.

Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti searches any Fish monster (except itself) on Special Summon and banishes 1 Fish from your hand or field; when banished itself, it can banish 1 Fish from your hand, GY, or face-up field to Special Summon itself.

Arionpos, Serpent of the Ghoti (Level 6 Synchro) banishes a Level 6 or lower Fish from your Deck on Synchro Summon and banishes a Fish from your GY when used as Synchro Material to search a Fish of equal or lower Level.

summary.title: Opening: Paces + Psiics (or Any Level 4 Fish)
steps: Normal Summon Paces, Light of the Ghoti and banish it to Special Summon Psiics, Moonlight of the Ghoti from the hand (or Synchro Summon Level 6 Arionpos, Serpent of the Ghoti using Paces and a Level 4 Fish).

On Synchro Summon, use Arionpos to banish Shif, Fairy of the Ghoti or Psiics from the Deck; if Psiics is banished, banish a Fish from the GY to Special Summon Psiics, which searches Zep, Ruby of the Ghoti and banishes it.
Zep triggers immediately when banished during your turn (or on the opponent's turn to Synchro Summon), returning or setting up your banished Tuners.
In the next Standby Phase, Paces and Shif Special Summon themselves from banishment, ready to Quick-Synchro on the opponent's Main Phase into Askaan, the Bicorned Ghoti and Ghoti of the Deep Beyond.

summary.title: Opponent's Turn Quick-Synchro Engine
summary.text: When Paces, Shif, or Zep are Special Summoned during the opponent's turn, they can immediately Synchro Summon a Fish Synchro Monster during the opponent's Main Phase. Zep, Ruby of the Ghoti can even Special Summon itself on the opponent's turn if it is banished while they act (via Snopios, Shade of the Ghoti or Keaf, Murk of the Ghoti), immediately performing a Fish Synchro Summon on arrival. Snopios banishes 2 Fish from your hand and/or GY as a Quick Effect to summon itself, and Keaf banishes an opponent's newly Special Summoned monster along with itself to summon a Level 6 or lower banished Fish.

summary.title: Synchro Bosses & Traps
points: Ghoti of the Deep Beyond (Level 10) banishes all cards on the field when Synchro Summoned during the opponent's turn, returns from banishment in the next Standby Phase if banished from the Monster Zone, and gains 500 ATK for every banished monster.
Askaan, the Bicorned Ghoti (Level 8) banishes 1 Fish you control and 1 card the opponent controls on Synchro Summon, then banishes a Fish from your GY to revive itself when banished.
Guoglim, Spear of the Ghoti banishes any opponent's monster it battles at the start of the Damage Step and banishes itself in the Standby Phase to revive its Synchro Materials.

Ghoti Chain banishes a face-up Fish to summon a differently named Ghoti from your hand, Deck, GY, or banishment; Ghoti Fury temporarily banishes your Fish and an opponent's monster; and Ghoti Cosmos calls a Fish Synchro from the Extra Deck when 8+ Fish are banished.
